messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating migration migration/2026-04-index-add on tenant_profile (shard=7). Holding lock: exclusive index build. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Pin: v2.8.4. Rollback policy per runbook. Starting in ~30s.
maria: Saw a short spike on shard 7 earlier, tagging @oliver to watch the lock queue.
sam: If there's any long-running SELECT FOR UPDATE we should abort — last time analytics job caused a 20m hang.
oliver: On it, connecting to PG console and tailing lock table.
opsbot: Alert: pg_lock_waiters > 5 on shard7 at 02:01 UTC (threshold=3) :red_circle:
deploy-bot: Pausing migration due to lock queue exceed. Paused at step: create_index_concurrently. Will retry in 5m and escalate if persists. thread: migration/2026-04-index-add
oliver: Confirmed 3 pids blocking: 5421 (analytics_worker), 5533 (adhoc_report), 5600 (stuck txn). Recommend terminating 5421 first.
sam: +1 — kill analytics job, it'll requeue but better than blocking index.
maria: Can ops flip the analytics feature-flag for 10m so it doesn't restart? ops can toggle.
oliver: Running: ```SELECT pg_terminate_backend(5421);``` -> success. pg_stat_activity shows backlog decreasing.
opsbot: Notice: pg_lock_waiters dropped to 1 on shard7.
deploy-bot: Retrying migration step in 30s. ETA resume 02:07 UTC. If locks reappear >2m we'll abort and schedule next window. :rocket:
sam: I'll stay on call 02:05-02:15 to monitor.
maria: Adding release-note blurb: 'Index build for tenant_profile deferred briefly due to concurrent jobs; resumed after terminating blocked queries.'
deploy-bot: Migration step completed successfully at 02:09 UTC. Closing thread. Rollout note: index added on shard7. Canary OK.
